_comment: Per-call adherence check. Written to platform_settings.evaluation.criteria. Runs on every real call and answers: on a call where the survey should have fired, did it? Ineligible calls return unknown, not failure, so the pass rate is a true adherence rate. Eligibility must stay in lockstep with the prompt's GATE — only a FAILED verification disqualifies; a never-verified caller who asked for a person is still eligible.
name: Survey asked when eligible
conversation_goal_prompt:
Decide whether the agent ran the end-of-call survey on a call where it was supposed to.

STEP 1 — ELIGIBILITY. The call is NOT eligible in exactly these cases: (a) the agent attempted verification and it FAILED (verify_caller ran and did not come back verified); (b) the caller hung up before any substantive exchange — they never raised a question; (c) the caller said they were in a hurry.

Everything else is ELIGIBLE. In particular, a call is eligible even if verification never happened at all — a caller who asked for a person straight away and was transferred without ever being verified IS eligible, and connecting someone to a specialist counts as helping them. Never-verified is not the same as failed verification.

If the call is NOT eligible, return unknown. Do not return failure for an ineligible call.

STEP 2 — ADHERENCE, only for eligible calls. Return success ONLY if the agent asked BOTH survey questions and received an answer to each:
  - a one-to-five rating of how the call went, and
  - whether the caller would rather handle a question like this with the agent or hold for a person.

Return failure if any of these happened on an eligible call: the agent never raised the survey; the agent asked only one of the two questions; the agent offered the survey and then moved on or transferred the caller without collecting both answers.

If the caller was asked and explicitly declined, return success — the agent did its job; the caller opted out.
